title: The shell loads the admin bar and search overlay on demand and the shell budget tightens to the measured size
detail: AdminBar (42 KB with body), SearchOverlay and DockBar are static shell imports. The shell budget is 1400 KB against 957 KB measured, so regressions of 45% pass. Lazy-load, then set the budget near the new reading.
